name: cache
description: Installs and enables Memcached and Redis, including Redis authentication and log-directory management. It also post-processes the Redis configuration to remove replication-related directives.

name: fastapi-tutorial
description: Deploys the FastAPI tutorial application from Git with a Python virtual environment and Uvicorn systemd service. Installs local PostgreSQL and creates the FastAPI database role and database.

name: nginx-multisite
description: Configures Nginx as a three-site HTTPS server with static content and self-signed certificates. Applies firewall, Fail2ban, sysctl, and SSH hardening controls.
